description.en: Hold the knife, push, blow the dust away

howToPlay.zh: 照着篆刻师傅的工序刻一方四字印：先倒边，再刻边框、刻十字分成四格，最后一笔一笔刻字。刻刀分两个区域：按住白色刀柄拖动是移刀，按住红色握把（或刀身）划就是刻。刀只朝刀口的方向刻（刀柄的反方向），点「转刀」把刀原地转 90°，四个方向轮流换。把刀尖拖到稿线的一端，按住握把往刀口方向划，刀尖跟着手指一顿一顿地吃进石头，往回划会顺着刻过的槽退回，松手就提刀。刻偏了点「撤销」去掉最后一划，可以连续撤销；「重刻」可以只重刻当前这一步，或者整方从头再来。‹ › 转动印石。刻完按「吹」把石粉吹干净，印石转一圈展示，印蜕收进右上角的「印谱」，同时解锁下一方。印面上刻的是反字，盖出来才是正的。电脑上同理，用鼠标按住刀柄或握把拖动。键盘：方向键移刀，R 转刀，按住空格下刀，同时按刀口方向的方向键推、反方向往回拉，松开提刀，Z 撤销，Q 和 E 转动印石，B 吹粉，A 打开印谱。
howToPlay.en: Carve a four-character seal the way a seal carver does: chamfer the face's edges, cut the border, cut a cross into four cells, then carve the characters stroke by stroke. The knife has two zones: drag the white handle to move it, hold the red grip (or the blade) and swipe to carve. The knife carves only the way its edge points (away from the handle); Turn turns it a quarter in place. Set the tip at one end of a draft line, hold the grip and swipe the way the edge points: the tip follows your finger into the stone flake by flake, swiping back slides it down its own groove, and letting go lifts it. Undo takes back the last swipe, again and again; Redo starts the current step, or the whole seal, over. ‹ › turn the stone. When all is cut, Blow clears the powder, the stone turns once, and the print goes into Seals (top right) and the next seal opens. The face is carved mirrored so that it prints the right way round. With a mouse, drag the handle or the grip the same way. Keyboard: arrow keys move the knife, R turns it; hold Space to put it in, the arrow its edge points to pushes and the opposite one pulls back, let go to lift it; Z undoes, Q and E turn the stone, B blows, A opens your seals.
